items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain financial containment. Approve no new spend, monetization expansion, revenue forecast, ROI claim, or budget commitment. Amazon evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission; all $4.92 is aggregate tracking_id=other, so site revenue, contribution margin, CAC, ROI, and causal lift are unsupported. Named site rows show $0 attributed income; allthingsmasonic.com shows 61 clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission. AI usage on 2026-10-01 is 16 calls costing $2.2785467 across 4 instrumented sites; fleet AI cost-to-learn is not calculable because incremental outcomes and 34 sites' AI costs are missing. Infrastructure, fixed, and marketing budgets are blank, so total budget exposure and contribution margin are not calculable. Minimum measurement: daily site/content-level revenue, orders, shipped items, commission, direct change cost, AI cost, hosting/infrastructure cost, and attribution IDs reconciled to a common date range; for each change, record baseline, exposure, incremental outcome, and rollback cost. Continue only existing reversible work after capacity clears; reject unsupported forecasts and vanity metrics such as impressions, clicks, proposals, or shipped output without attributable financial outcomes.

CFO financial gate for the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA request: retain the 2026-09-21 baseline of 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission. If capacity clears, measure post-change clicks, orders, shipped items, commission, AI/infrastructure allocation, and direct change cost for 14 days or 100 relevant new impressions/clicks. Calculate contribution as attributable commission less directly attributable change, AI, and infrastructure costs only when those costs are available; otherwise classify the financial result as unknown. Do not claim revenue, ROI, margin, forecast, or causal lift. Preserve registered destinations and use a single-diff rollback.
